concept.en: Wants/Requires pull units in, After/Before set the order; a failed dependency

summary.hr: Uredi veze jedinice app.service, podigni sustav i gledaj tko je u transakciji, tko koga čeka i što se dogodi kad db ne uspije.
summary.en: Edit the relations of app.service, boot, and see who is in the transaction, who waits for whom and what happens when db fails.
